cells.value: Trials team embarked onboard at
for SATs of AICS LAMA (FASC) as per approved schedule, BR 4050 and CNO 07/10. Following observed: -
Check No. 2.1 - General Checks (AAV check, check of system performance against surface and air target including FCR acquisition and tracking).
Check No. 2.2 - FCR manual acquisition checks on a surface target.
Check No. 2.2.1 - Test requirement: test site must be clear of all interfacing obstacles.
Check No. 2.2.2 - FCR manual acquisition mode capability.
Check No. 2.2.3 - FCR auto acquisition and tracking of surface target.
Check No. 2.2.4 - FCR acquisition of surface target range performance (Maximum Range).
Check No. 2.2.4 - FCR acquisition of surface target range performance (Minimum Range).
Check No. 2.2.5 - Gun aiming check on a stationary surface target using FCR.
Check No. 2.2.6 - Gun aiming check on a surface target using EOD (Electro Optical Director).
Check No. 2.2.7 - Missile air target signal.
Check No. 2.2.8 - Track and AMDR surface target.
Check No. 2.3 - Checks on air target.
Check No. 2.3.1 - Antenna alignment verification test.
Check No. 2.3.2 - Test requirement.
Check No. 2.3.3 - FCR automatic acquisition and tracking of air target.
Check No. 2.3.4 - FCR acquisition of air target range performance.
Check No. 2.3.5 - FCR air search (message displayed on screen).
Check No. 2.4 - Reaction time test (performed on simulated mode only).
